description: UNDERSTANDING — One estate: the owning provider, the full member roster with per-member API counts and bands, and the estate-wide rating. Use get_provider_estate(slug) to go the other way, from a provider to the company that owns it. Priced B1 (single-entity synthesis) — $0.01 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include_next.description: Set false to omit the `next` affordance block.

slug.description: Estate slug — the owning company the estate is rooted at, as find_estates returns it, e.g. "cisco".

name: get_estate
